articles.title: Madhya Pradesh Traders Observe ‘No UPI Day’: Shopkeepers In Bhopal, Indore Reject Payments Above ₹2,000 Over MDR Charge | VIDEO
articles.description: Madhya Pradesh traders observed ‘No UPI Day’ protesting the proposed 0.4% MDR charge on UPI payments above ₹2,000. Traders in Bhopal, Indore and other cities covered QR scanners with black cloth and avoided high-value UPI transactions. Trade bodies said the charge would increase business costs, while petrol pump dealers also announced opposition from October 16.
